coloration._note: PACHY 2026-10-31 (owner: 'the color is off'): hue_deg was 355, read as +-355 deg (clamped to +-40), so wild animals rolled orange to purple hides; and a stripes pattern was drawn over the painted stripes. clips.attack_primary: dome butt: rock back, chin tucked so the dome faces the prey, drive the body forward off a planted step; the dome is the front-most point at the hit (0.42)
clips.attack_heavy: stomp: rears up on the left leg, right foot hauled high and held (telegraph), slammed down ahead (hit 0.72)
clips.kick: hip check: the rump and stiff tail slam round to the side and back at a prey behind it (hit 0.45)
clips.charge: head-down run-up, dome leading; the impact is the charge's body-slam shove
clips.alert: threat display: head lowered and dome presented, a stamp of the right foot, a snort

eyes.note: ray-cast onto the painted amber eye of the v2 mesh (symmetric), glTF Head-bone space

assumptions: # ASSUMPTION: height_meters 1.8 (dome top) for "pony-sized"; small saddle class (< 2.2 m)
# ASSUMPTION: stats, tier 16, capture tier I, taming foods modelled on zebraceratops (the other early herbivore mount); archetype pack_mule so the herd grazer charge/flee AI applies
# ASSUMPTION: real_length_m 4.5, climate grassland, clade/period are the real animal; no lore beyond the owner description

tactics._about: # ASSUMPTION (owner 2026-10-31: 'give it fight moves that suit a dome-headed brawler'): pack_mule's herd behaviour, display and head-down charge (the dome headbutt with knockback), plus at point blank a hip check (kick) when the prey is behind it, else a stomp (attack_heavy, its own cooldown), else a dome butt. Bigger shove than the other grazers: it is a head-butting specialist.
tactics._bull: PACHYBULL (owner 2026-10-31: 'instead of it walking back slowly, have it jump backwards and wind up like a bull, huff huff, and then charge'): after every charge (hit or miss) two quick back-hops of 1.6 m (hop_back clip, facing the prey), then the bull windup (display_clip bull_windup: head down, the right foot paws twice with a snort, 1.25 s) and the next charge. Any other back-off is a hop too (backoff leap), never pack_mule's walk_back scurry. # ASSUMPTION: distances, two hops, no miss stagger (the reset is the punish window).
tactics._pachyfeel: PACHYFEEL (owner 2026-10-31, fight lab: 'give it more backstep charges and make some charges go really far and some go shorter depending on the wind up', 'make it less passive aggressive', 'might have a walking backwards bug'). The bull charge (back-hop, windup, charge) is the main sequence (bull_charge weight 4 of 6) and every back-off is a bull reset (backoff_bull, TacticalBrain._back_off); the windup's tier (ai.json bull_windup) sets how far and fast the charge runs. After the line it wheels round on a tight arc at a run (charge_arc_*), facing her before the hops, so hop_back never plays while the body travels forward. The dome throws her 45 deg off the line (charge_toss_deg) and it runs on through (charge_pass): it used to shove her along in front of it and the line stalled at ~6.6 m whatever the windup. One back-hop of 2 m (bull_hops 1, bull_hop_m 2; PACHYBULL had two of 1.6 m) keeps the reset quick. charge_cd 3 (was 6), shorter circles and guard_m 40 (was 16: the fight drifted past its home's 16 m and it stood down mid-fight). # ASSUMPTION: every number.
